our compression scheme is the most efficient way to compress BVHs on parametric patches and that it is the most effective way to reduce memory requirements of ray tracing parametric surfaces.

we can render complex scenes with displacement on the GPU with a memory consumption that is comparable to that of a simple polygonal model.
our compression scheme is applicable to a wide variety of BVH-based acceleration structures, and thus can be used in a broad range of ray-tracing applications.
